entities.summary: Cameron David Krutwig is an American professional basketball player for Hiopos Lleida of the Spanish Liga ACB. Nicknamed "King Krut", he played college basketball for the Loyola Ramblers. Krutwig drew national attention after helping the 2017–18 Ramblers reach the Final Four of the 2018 NCAA tournament.
